description: Phase 2D: user toggles to lifeline-strict on day 1. Channel-blocking is identical to subscription-url-unreachable. Asserts the V2.5 behavioural overlay: scheduled refresh is gated out (skipped_lifeline_strict), user-triggered refresh fires, the per-session bulk-capable opt-in flag round-trips through diagnostics, and toggling back to normal restores cadence.
